provenance.decode_step_definition: s1 is each actual suffix-prefill query predicting first generated token (selector compatibility only); s16/s64/s256 are same-forward ready-group snapshots anchored on question0 prediction step, with each request's own actual position retained
provenance.mask_definition: Budget applies to the full original document; protected partial-page document tail resides in private suffix and is omitted from common-source masks only. All original selected tokens remain in execution.

scope: Warm planning and second-card replay of selected qualified plans, including explicit native full union; not exhaustive joint optimization over every plan's preparation cost.
limitations: Amortization counts are scenarios, not measured reuse lifetimes; oracle search and preparation are separate costs.
No throughput, queueing, quality, ready-window or energy claim follows.
Python metadata construction is an implementation cost; its optimization alone is not evidence of a new attention mechanism.
